evidence.quote: Many participants indicated that the case for somewhat more accommodative policy had strengthened.
Many judged additional monetary policy accommodation would be warranted in the near term should these recent developments prove to be sustained and continue to weigh on the economic outlook.
Participants generally agreed that downside risks to the outlook for economic activity had risen materially since their May meeting
many participants viewed the risks to the outlook for inflation as weighted to the downside.
the economy appeared to have lost some momentum
members agreed to remove the "patient" language

parsed.rationale: The minutes describe a hold but strongly signal near-term easing, with downside risks to growth and inflation emphasized, removal of 'patient' language, and dissent favoring a cut. Only a few participants pushed back against easing, leaving a clearly dovish net signal.
